title: UX Search Filter Sort Compiler
description: Validates search, filter, and sort interaction specs: filter type validity, no-results states, sort direction declarations, loading states, filter persistence, and contract attestation. Produces search-filter-sort-artifact.json.

pipeline.title: Parse Intent
pipeline.description: Extract search-filter-sort-spec.json from feature brief and entity definitions

pipeline.title: Structure
pipeline.description: Validate spec shape, required fields, and filter type validity

pipeline.title: Behavior
pipeline.description: Validate no-results state, sort direction, and loading state declarations

gates.title: Spec Valid
gates.description: search-filter-sort-spec.json exists with entity(string), filters(array), sorts(array); each filter has id+label+type; each sort has id+label+field

gates.title: Filter Types Valid
gates.description: Every filter.type must be one of: text, select, multi-select, range, date-range, boolean, tag

gates.title: No Results State
gates.description: Spec must declare noResultsState with message and at least one action; escape hatch: noResultsHandledGlobally:true

gates.title: Sort Direction
gates.description: Every sort entry must declare defaultDirection: asc or desc

gates.title: Partial Results / Loading State
gates.description: Spec must declare loadingState with type: skeleton, spinner, or progressive; escape hatch: loadingHandledGlobally:true

gates.title: Filter Persistence
gates.description: Spec must declare persistence: session, url, none, or user-preference

gates.title: Search Filter Sort Contract
gates.description: Version, entity declared, unique filter ids, unique sort ids

contracts.description: Structural requirements for all compiled search, filter, and sort specs

error_codes.USS001: search-filter-sort-spec.json missing or invalid — entity, filters, sorts required
error_codes.USS002: noResultsState missing or invalid — message and clearFiltersAction or suggestionsEnabled required
error_codes.USS003: Invalid filter type — must be text, select, multi-select, range, date-range, boolean, or tag
error_codes.USS004: Sort entry missing defaultDirection — must be asc or desc
error_codes.USS005: loadingState missing or invalid — type must be skeleton, spinner, or progressive
error_codes.USS006: persistence missing — must be session, url, none, or user-preference
error_codes.USS007: Search filter sort contract violation — version, entity, unique filter ids, unique sort ids required
